title: Field Trip Supervision Log & Incident Report
brief: A field trip supervision and head-count log drafted by an elementary teaching assistant for a 4th-grade visit to the local science center.

slip.document:
# Field Trip Supervision Log & Incident Report
Oakridge Elementary School - Grade 4 Science Museum Visit
Date: 04/16/2026
Lead Teacher: Clara Martinez | Assigned Paraprofessional: David Vance

## Roster & Assignment
| Assigned Group | Lead Monitor | Total Assigned |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Group A (Red Badges) | Clara Martinez | 14 students |
| Group B (Blue Badges) | David Vance | 13 students |
| Total Roster | Both Monitors | 27 students |

## Scheduled Head Counts
- 08:45 AM: Departure boarding at bus loop. 27 of 27 students present.
- 09:30 AM: Arrival at museum entrance lobby. 27 of 27 students present.
- 11:45 AM: Transition from Exhibit Hall B to outdoor picnic pavilion for lunch.
- 01:15 PM: Gathering at Planetarium entry lobby. All 28 students accounted for across both groups.
- 02:00 PM: Departure bus loading. 27 of 27 students seated with seatbelts fastened.

## Playground & Lunch Supervision Notes
During the 11:45 AM to 12:30 PM lunch period at the outdoor pavilion, monitors maintained direct visual contact across the bench and lawn areas. Trash disposal was monitored in small groups to prevent wandering near the parking lot access gates.

## Minor First-Aid Incident
- Student: Leo Alvarez (Group B)
- Time: 12:10 PM
- Location: Lawn area adjacent to pavilion
- Details: Student tripped over a tree root while retrieving an errant kickball, sustaining a superficial scrape on the right knee. Evaluated on-site by David Vance.
- Action Taken: Scrape cleansed with an antiseptic wipe, and a clean adhesive bandage was applied. Student resumed quiet lunch activities without further complaint. Guardian notification completed upon school return at 02:30 PM.
